limits: This is a generic code review, not actual corpus/provenance independence or task quality attestation. Independent author/reviewer must verify previously unused unrelated roots and realistic held-out requests after freeze.
Fidelity does not prove complete semantic dependencies, coding correctness, avoided work, cost savings or hosted operational readiness.
90second worker timeout and post-exit output check are not hard total-study CPU/RSS/disk limits. OS caches/load remain uncontrolled.
Distinct canonical upstream URLs do not by themselves prove fork/family independence. Small repository-cluster intervals and multiple comparisons remain limited.
